name: VesselBerthScheduler
tagline: Berth plan, conflict checks, crane plan and vessel status in one drop-in Power Apps control for terminals and ports.
description: Plans every port call on a berths × time board with drag-and-drop and keyboard moves, checks length, draft, cranes and shared quay space with clearance and buffer, suggests and auto-allocates the smallest free berth, plans quay cranes against the crane pool and runs each call from Planned to Confirmed, Alongside, Working and Departed with ATA / ATD.
features: Drag & drop and keyboard berth allocation
Overlap, length, draft and crane checks
Hourly crane demand vs crane pool
Working hours and completion vs ETD
Status workflow with roles, ATA / ATD and supervisor override
Phone berth line-up with bottom view bar
